headlines.title: Stocks fall, bond yields surge and oil fluctuates as war keeps markets on edge
headlines.description: Stocks fell Monday alongside a jump in bond yields and erratic oil trading as geopolitical upheaval remained front and center for traders.

headlines.title: Trump unveils plans for a $15 billion steel mill in Iowa
headlines.description: Mesabi Metallics, which is building the plant, aims to start production in 2030, a White House official said.

headlines.title: Gas cost calculator: How much have higher gas prices cost you?
headlines.description: Americans have spent an estimated $40 billion more in gas since the Iran war started. According to an NBC News analysis, drivers who fill up twice a month paid anywhere from $20 to $300 more for gas.

headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.

headlines.title: Money-Saving Strategies as Grocery Price Wars Get Underway
headlines.description: Food prices are higher overall this year, but now major chains including Aldi, Walmart, Target and Amazon, are offering deals to lure customers back. NBC’s Christine Romans joins TODAY with how to maximize your savings at the checkout line. Tips include using cash back apps, joining loyalty clubs, shopping in-season and local fruits and vegetables, and more.

headlines.title: Mortgage Rates Hit Highest Level in More Than 2 Years
headlines.description: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate is averaging 7.45%, its highest level in more than two years, making it even harder for Americans to jump into the housing market. NBC’s Christine Romans joins TODAY to break down why rates are rising and what it means for borrowers and savers.

headlines.title: McDonald’s leans into AI and new menu items to attract customers
headlines.description: McDonald’s plans to invest $8.5 billion in its new “NEXT" strategy using AI technology to modernize restaurants and introducing new menu items to reach more customers. NBC News’ Allie Canal breaks down what the company’s next chapter could look like.

headlines.title: Early Deals on Holiday Shopping: What to Buy, Trends to Look For
headlines.description: With Christmas three months away, NBC’s Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY to talk about why you should start your holiday shopping now, lists October shopping events, explains what items are worth waiting for Black Friday and Cyber Monday, the gift trends to watch for, and more!

headlines.title: Should you bring iced coffee to a job interview? Question brews generational debate
headlines.description: What started as a conversation about job interview tips online escalated into a generational debate over whether it’s taboo to show up with an iced coffee to talk to a potential employer.

headlines.title: The U.S. economy before and after the Iran war, in five charts
headlines.description: Nearly seven months in, the conflict now casts a cloud of uncertainty — with no end in sight.

headlines.title: New York Times executive fatally shot by his in-laws in Bay Area park, police say
headlines.description: Jonathan McKinsey, head of engineering and games player experiences for the Times, was found on the ground at a park with multiple gunshot wounds, police said.

headlines.title: White House access restored for media outlets, but some reporters were denied hours later
headlines.description: In granting a temporary restraining order while the news outlets’ legal challenge proceeds, the judge said that Trump’s ban was likely unconstitutional.
